description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's 'send-pack' functionality, including setup of references, pushing refs via command line and stdin, and validation of ref updates behavior.

methods.name: create_ref
methods.description: Creates a new git reference with specified name and commit message.

methods.name: clear_remote
methods.description: Initializes an empty bare remote repository named remote.git.

methods.name: verify_push
methods.description: Verifies that a specific ref has been successfully pushed to the remote repository by comparing rev-parse outputs.
